summary: Credit-card-footprint USB desktop device using a Seeed Studio XIAO, an upper 2.25-inch TFT, four lower physical keys, and an integrated USB microphone.

required_interfaces.description: Complete product XY projection must not exceed 85.60 mm x 53.98 mm in landscape orientation; body thickness target is 12 mm maximum subject to component verification.
Retain and expose the LT225C7-C08-03 TFT with a visible upper-front display area, protected edges, cable clearance, and serviceable assembly.
Provide four independently operable physical keys in one horizontal row below the screen with sufficient spacing to avoid routine mis-presses.
Expose one mechanically supported USB-C device connection for power, USB HID keyboard, and USB Audio Class microphone operation.
Provide an unobstructed microphone acoustic path suitable for near-field desktop speech while protecting the microphone from direct handling contact.
Retain the final PCB assembly and prevent visible flex during normal key actuation and USB-C insertion/removal.

external_references.description: Uploaded visual reference showing the intended upper-screen and lower-four-key composition.
LT225C7-C08-03 2.25-inch TFT LCD module product specification, version 1.0 dated 2024-07-04. Full mechanical and electrical pages require verification before hardware freeze.
Exact verified board specification and STEP model for the selected Seeed Studio XIAO variant; selection is governed by the capability constraints in the approved PRD.

assembly_story.installation: Install the display, four switches, microphone, XIAO-based PCB assembly, and supported USB-C interface into the enclosure, then close the enclosure without stressing the display cable or PCB.
assembly_story.maintenance: The enclosure should allow prototype-stage reopening for PCB, display, or key service without destructive access.

documents.description: Manufacturable enclosure assembly around the final PCB, exact XIAO board, LT225C7-C08-03 display, four keys, microphone opening, and USB-C access while respecting the credit-card XY envelope.
